blocks.html: Yitschaq/Isaac, who was born miraculously to Avraham and Sarah, was the chosen one. They believed that their son Yishma’el was the solution to their desire for a child. They not only stopped making an effort, but Sarah's reproductive ability was no longer functional, and she initially doubted the fulfilment of the prophecy regarding Ishmael. This can be attributed to the fact that יהוה utilized Avraham's biological seed in the miraculous conception.
